body.p: Please replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application with the following list of claims. Additions are indicated by underlining and deletions are indicated by strikeouts and/or double bracketing.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) An article for inserting a particle into a cell, the article comprising:
a member comprising a starting portion, an end portion for insertion into a cell, and a tapered portion connecting the starting portion to the end portion, wherein the starting portion has [[an]] a substantially constant average cross-sectional diameter of at least about 100 micrometers and is suitable for guiding the end portion to be inserted into the cell, the end portion for insertion into the cell has [[an]] a substantially constant average cross- sectional diameter of between about 100 nm and about 2 micrometers less than 100 nm and a length of between about 750 micrometers and about 3 mm, and the tapered portion connecting the starting portion to the end portion has a length of no more than about 500 micrometers; and
at least one particle attached to the end portion of the member, wherein the at least one particle is positioned in an optically interrogatable position with respect to light transmitted through the member to the end portion, wherein the at least one particle is attached to the end portion of the member via an adhesive positioned between the at least one particle and the end portion of the member, wherein the adhesive comprises at least one of a polymer or an epoxy.
2. (Original) The article of claim 1, wherein the member comprises a metal.
3. (Previously presented) The article of claim 1, wherein the member comprises glass.
